thread:
Ravi (Product): Quick thread to lock the observability roadmap slice we promised customers: route cost breakdown, lightweight trace hooks, and error analytics with sample payloads. Need final scope and launch gates.

Asha (Eng-runtime): Feasible but must be async and opt-in for heavy traces. Plan: emit minimal span envelopes from runtime; sampling default 0.5%; dynamic overrides by route/latency.

Ben (Eng-SRE): Ops constraints: per-org daily cap, burst capture mode, retention presets (7/30/90). Require load test with synthetic spans at 5x expected before beta.

Noemi (Design): UI proposal: three compact cards - Cost (route/model breakdown + sparkline), Traces (sampled table + link to flamegraph), Errors (grouped, count, sample toggle). I'll provide mocks for desktop + mobile.

Ivy (Data): Metric schema: tags=[org_id, route_id, model, variant], fields=[tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, success]. Cost calc = tokens * model.unit_cost + est infra fee. Backfill: opt-in 30d recompute via batch job, warn about duration.

Ravi (Product): Proposed launch gates: (1) per-route cost within 7% of billing for beta orgs, (2) trace capture adds <12% p99 latency, (3) error analytics surfaces top-5 groups with sample for >=80% groups. Canary: 3 customers + internal.

Asha (Eng-runtime): Implementation notes: nonblocking plugin hook around model call; async uploader to trace pipeline; sampling rules example: {"default":0.005, "overrides":[{"route":"chat-stream","rate":0.02},{"latency_gt_ms":800,"rate":1.0}]}.

Ben (Eng-SRE): Rollback triggers: sustained p99 regression >15%, trace ingestion >2x autoscale forecast, or cost attribution variance >10% impacting billing. I'll add alerts and quotas.

Noemi (Design): UX acceptance: drilldown from cost row to related traces/errors; sample inputs redacted by default with opt-in reveal; compact table for large orgs.

Ivy (Data): Backfill estimate: ~3 CPU-hours per 100M requests. Will gate backfills and add a confirmation step in console.

Ravi (Product): Action items: Asha/Ben -> ETA + perf test plan by EOD tomorrow; Ivy -> publish schema + backfill runbook; Noemi -> mocks by EOD. I'll open beta invite ticket and draft the launch checklist.

Asha (Eng-runtime): Will post RFC with perf targets and sampling API by tomorrow.

Ben (Eng-SRE): Adding sizing doc now.

pm-bot: Ticket OBS-3141 created: "Console observability slice: cost/traces/errors" -> https://redwood.example/OBS-3141

Ravi (Product): Thanks all. If no objections I'll lock priorities after RFCs.

Asha (Eng-runtime): SGTM.

Noemi (Design): SGTM.
